title: SPORT Magazine March 1992 Swimsuit Issue Symba Smith Vintage
descriptionText:
SPORT magazine, March 1992 issue — "Sizzling Swimsuit Issue" featuring Symba Smith, newsstand edition, cover price $2.95. Includes the fold-out poster. Also has period advertising (Right Guard / Charles Barkley on back cover).
Vintage magazine — has a crease/wear line across the top of the front cover (see photos); otherwise intact. Ships in a protective sleeve/board.
